ret: 3 training days (A, B and C) holding 5 exercises, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day A, then Day B, then Day C.

Attendance: Do at least 3 quads, hamstrings or glutes sessions in each 7-day window (from your start day); train at least 3 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
squat: 3 sets of 5 reps on Barbell Back Squat; add 2.5 kg after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight.
rdl: 3 sets of Romanian Deadlift in the phase rep range, starting at nothing; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches the top of the range.
thrust: 3 sets of Barbell Hip Thrust in the phase rep range, starting at nothing; add 5 kg once every set reaches the top of the range.
bench: 3 sets of 5 reps on Barbell Bench Press; add 1.25 kg after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight.
row: 3 sets of Chest-Supported Row in the phase rep range, starting at nothing; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches the top of the range.

Reads your estimated max (kept on file; ignored once older than 56 days).

Starts with working weight = whichever is known first: (1) nothing; (2) the load you could lift for 12 reps with 2 in reserve, given an estimated max of your estimated max for Romanian Deadlift; written by session, owner.
Plan: Romanian Deadlift: 3 sets of 8–12 reps at your working weight.

After each session: Set working weight to whichever is known first: (1) (if every working set reached the top of its range: your working weight plus 2.5 kg; if a working set fell short: your working weight; if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: your working weight); (2) the best load you logged on “work”.
